towns.name: Silyun
towns.summary: Silyun (87.3N 70.6W, Traitor's Island) is the home of the remnants of the Duke of Bellenesse's rebellion: a Viamontian town where the Grand Mother, from the balcony of the great hall, recruits for the Whispering Blade while a truce with King Varicci II's loyalists barely holds. It sits on a mesa top (z 80): the two-storey great hall with a golden roof and columns (to z 98) carries braziers, paper lanterns and purple stag banners on its balcony; before it a plaza holds the 9 m Statue of Eleonora du Bellenesse in a flower bed ringed by golden blue-flame lamps and benches; the Town Network portal and the Life Stone lie west; a temple-tower smithy with an open forge, anvil, bellows and hanging chains stands south; stone cottages with smoking chimneys and giant trees 40-55 m tall surround the town.
